# Written by make crosscheck; DO NOT EDIT.
#
# Each line is one place where the sources of the standard properties
# disagree: the captures of the bare drivers, conventions.yaml, the
# simulator transcripts, the units of the fields files in schema/, and
# the standard properties page of indilib/docs. The generator reads
# none of the page, so no line here changes the schema. A person
# decides what each line means.
#
# indilib/docs commit: a1d5584e3db4bda83699d77fc81e7ba47ad4364d
CCD_ABORT_EXPOSURE: the standard properties page gives the type "Number", and the capture of ccd gives "Switch"
CCD_FILE_PATH: the standard properties page lists it for ccd, and no source defines it
CCD_ROTATION: the standard properties page lists it for ccd, and no source defines it
CCD_STREAM_RECORDER: the standard properties page names the member OGV, and the capture of ccd does not define it
EQUATORIAL_COORD: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
FILTER_NAME: the capture of filter defines the member FILTER_SLOT_NAME_*, and the standard properties page does not name it
FILTER_NAME: the standard properties page names the member FILTER_NAME_VALUE, and the capture of filter does not define it
FLAT_LIGHT_FILTER_INTENSITY: the standard properties page lists it for lightbox, and no source defines it
FOCUS_TEMPERATURE: conventions.yaml gives the permission "ro", and the focus simulator gives "rw"
FPS.AVG_FPS: the standard properties page gives the unit s, and cameras-fields.yaml gives fps
FPS.AVG_FPS: the standard properties page gives the unit s, and receivers-fields.yaml gives fps
GUIDER_ABORT_EXPOSURE: the standard properties page gives the type "Number", and the capture of ccd gives "Switch"
HORIZONTAL_COORD: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
JOYSTICK_LOCK_AXIS: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
MOTION_CONTROL_MODE: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
ON_COORD_SET: the capture of telescope defines the member FLIP, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_INFO: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
TELESCOPE_JOYSTICK_REVERSE: the standard properties page lists it for telescope, and no source defines it
TELESCOPE_PARK_POSITION: the capture of telescope defines the member PARK_HA, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_PARK_POSITION: the standard properties page gives the unit deg, and mounts-fields.yaml gives label
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the capture of telescope defines the member 1x, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the capture of telescope defines the member 2x, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the capture of telescope defines the member 3x, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the capture of telescope defines the member 4x, and the standard properties page does not name it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the standard properties page names the member SLEW_CENTERING, and the capture of telescope does not define it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the standard properties page names the member SLEW_FIND, and the capture of telescope does not define it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the standard properties page names the member SLEW_GUIDE, and the capture of telescope does not define it
TELESCOPE_SLEW_RATE: the standard properties page names the member SLEW_MAX, and the capture of telescope does not define it
